issues.t: Rear axle seals leak gear oil onto the brakes
issues.sym: Oily wetness on the inside of a rear wheel or tire, a burnt-oil smell, weak or grabbing rear brakes, a parking brake that will not hold, or a grinding noise from a rear wheel.
issues.why: The rear axle can build up heat and pressure when its vent cannot breathe freely. That pushes gear oil past the axle shaft seals, where it soaks the brake parts and can starve the wheel bearing of oil. Nissan issued a bulletin about the rear axle breather. Early trucks (2004-2006) are hit hardest.
issues.next: Have the seals and wheel bearings checked as soon as you see oil on the wheel. Oil-soaked brake pads or shoes must be replaced, not cleaned. Ask about the updated breather so the new seals last.

issues.t: Rear differential whine, grinding or failure
issues.sym: A whine or howl that changes with speed, clunking or grinding from the rear, or shuddering in tight turns. In bad cases the rear wheels can bind.
issues.why: The rear differential on early Titans is a known weak point, especially the locking version. Water and dirt can get in through the axle vent and wear the gears. Most failures are on 2004-2006 trucks; later units were stronger but still fail.
issues.next: Check the axle oil level and look for metal or milky oil. A growing whine should be looked at before the gears break. Repair is often a rebuild or a used or new axle assembly.

issues.t: Cracked exhaust manifold ticking
issues.sym: A ticking or puffing sound that is loudest on a cold start and may fade as the engine warms. You may also smell exhaust, lose some power and fuel economy, or see a check engine light.
issues.why: The cast exhaust manifolds on the first-generation 5.6L V8 crack after years of heating and cooling, usually near 100,000 miles. Later reinforcements did not fully cure it. Leaks can upset the air-fuel reading and, over time, harm the catalytic converters.
issues.next: Have a shop confirm where the leak is. Replace the cracked manifold (or both) with new gaskets and studs. Aftermarket headers are an option where emissions rules allow them.

issues.t: Radiator cracks and can mix coolant into the transmission
issues.sym: Coolant leaking from the bottom of the radiator, a dropping coolant level, or transmission fluid that looks pink and milky. The transmission may then shudder, slip or shift badly.
issues.why: The plastic fittings at the bottom of the factory radiator can crack. The transmission cooler is built into the radiator, so an internal leak lets coolant and transmission fluid mix, which can ruin the transmission.
issues.next: Fix any radiator leak right away. If the radiator is original, many owners replace it early and add a separate transmission cooler. If the fluid is already milky, have the transmission flushed and checked before more damage is done.

issues.t: Catalytic converters break up and damage the engine
issues.sym: A rotten-egg smell, check engine light with converter codes (P0420 or P0430), loss of power at higher rpm, and later rattling, oil burning or blue smoke when slowing down.
issues.why: The converters sit right next to the engine. If misfires, a rich mixture or a weak fuel pump overheat them, the inside crumbles. The fine dust can be drawn back into the cylinders and score them, which leads to oil burning.
issues.next: Do not ignore misfires or converter codes. Have the converters and fuel delivery checked early; replacing converters before the dust reaches the engine can prevent an engine rebuild.

issues.t: Clicking behind the dash from blend door actuators
issues.sym: A clicking or tapping noise behind the dashboard, air that will not change between vents, or hot air on one side and cold on the other.
issues.why: The small electric motors that move the heating and A/C doors wear out. The Titan has several of them and more than one can fail.
issues.next: Have the HVAC system tested to find which actuator is bad. Some actuators are hard to reach behind the dash.

issues.t: Front brake judder and groaning
issues.sym: A shaking steering wheel or pulsing brake pedal when stopping from speed, or a groaning noise from the front brakes.
issues.why: Uneven wear and thickness variation in the front rotors cause judder on early Titans. Nissan put out several service bulletins for front brake judder and a separate one for front brake groaning.
issues.next: Have the front rotors measured. A dealer can resurface them on the truck or fit updated pads and rotors under the bulletin procedure.

issues.t: Clunk or vibration from the driveshaft
issues.sym: A clunk when you pull away or shift between Drive and Reverse, or a vibration felt through the floor at certain speeds.
issues.why: A dry or worn driveshaft slip joint or U-joint makes a clunk when it moves. Nissan has a bulletin for driveshaft U-joint noise and vibration on these trucks.
issues.next: Ask a shop to grease the driveshaft slip joint and check the U-joints for play. Worn U-joints should be replaced before they fail.

issues.t: Engine control relay can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly stalls or will not start.
issues.why: Contacts inside the engine control relay in the under-hood fuse box can build up a coating and lose power to the engine computer.
issues.next: Get the free relay replacement if it has not been done. If the truck stalls, steer to a safe spot.

issues.t: Fuel gauge shows fuel when the tank is empty (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge can show about a quarter tank when the tank is actually empty, so the truck runs out of gas without warning.
issues.why: The fuel level reading can be wrong at the bottom of the tank. Nissan also has service bulletins for gauges that read full, respond slowly, or are inaccurate.
issues.next: Have the recall done. Until then, refuel early and track your mileage.

issues.t: A/C condenser fan motor can overheat and burn (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the front of the truck, often after rain or a car wash, or an A/C fan that stops working.
issues.why: Water can get into the condenser fan motor, corrode it and make it overheat, which can start a fire.
issues.next: Have the free fan motor replacement done. Stop and shut the engine off if you see smoke.

issues.t: King Cab door wiring can break and disable airbag parts (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on, often in a King Cab that is used a lot.
issues.why: Wiring that runs through the King Cab rear doors can break from repeated opening, which affects the seat belt pretensioner and passenger airbag circuits.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the recall by VIN and repair the wiring.

issues.t: Brake pedal pivot pin can slip out (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels loose or unusual and stopping power drops.
issues.why: The pin the brake pedal pivots on was not formed to spec and can slide partly out.
issues.next: Have the free pedal repair done right away.

issues.t: Weak lower control link welds (recall)
issues.sym: Handling feels loose or wanders.
issues.why: Welds on a rear suspension lower link may be weaker than spec on trucks built late 2009 to early 2010, so a collar can separate.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and replace the link.

issues.t: Steering wheel emblem can break off in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs. The risk is only in a crash.
issues.why: The Nissan emblem on the driver airbag cover can crack and fly off when the airbag deploys.
issues.next: Have the driver airbag cover replaced for free.

issues.t: Column shifter can fail to hold Park (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter feels loose or the truck can move after being put in Park.
issues.why: The column shift lever can be damaged so the part that holds the truck in Park may not work.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and get the free shifter repair.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder can reduce front brake pressure (recall)
issues.sym: Longer stopping distances or a pedal that feels different from time to time.
issues.why: The brake master cylinder can intermittently send less pressure to the front brakes.
issues.next: Get the free master cylinder repair right away.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs. In a crash the airbag can burst and throw metal pieces.
issues.why: The driver airbag inflator can rupture when it deploys.
issues.next: Treat this as urgent. Have the airbag replaced for free as soon as possible.

issues.t: Knocking from cylinder 7 (scored cylinder wall)
issues.sym: A sharp tick or knock that is loudest on a cold start, sometimes before 50,000 miles, and may grow louder with time. Oil use can rise.
issues.why: Cylinder number 7 on the direct-injection 5.6L V8 can get scored. Nissan has a bulletin telling dealers to look inside with a camera and replace the engine block if deep scoring is found.
issues.next: Have a dealer check it under bulletin NTB19-057 while you are still under warranty. Keep records of oil changes and the noise.

issues.t: Harsh shifts and shudder from the 7-speed automatic
issues.sym: Hard or clunky downshifts when slowing, hunting between gears, or a shudder at 20-40 mph.
issues.why: The 7-speed automatic in gas Titans had shift-calibration and torque-converter problems. Nissan released software updates and a torque converter bulletin.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for software updates. If shudder continues, the torque converter may need replacing.

issues.t: Diesel turbo actuator failure and low power
issues.sym: A warning light, reduced engine power, and codes P00AF or P0299.
issues.why: The turbo actuator circuit board can crack its solder joints, and carbon can build up on the high-pressure turbo. Nissan extended coverage on these parts to 10 years or 150,000 miles.
issues.next: Take it to a Nissan dealer. If you already paid for this repair, ask about reimbursement.

issues.t: Diesel EGR cooler leaks coolant
issues.sym: A reduced-power warning, coolant level going down with no puddle, a sweet coolant smell, or white smoke.
issues.why: The EGR cooler, which cools exhaust gas before it re-enters the engine, can crack inside. It is most common on 2016-2017 trucks but still happens on later ones.
issues.next: Do not keep driving with low coolant. Have the cooler pressure-tested and replaced to avoid overheating damage.

issues.t: Diesel crankshaft breakage
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power, loud banging or knocking, heavy shaking and many warning lights at once.
issues.why: Some early 5.0L Cummins engines broke their crankshafts. Nissan revised the design, but some 2017 trucks may still have the old part.
issues.next: Stop the engine and have it towed. Check whether the truck is still under powertrain warranty.

issues.t: Diesel fuel lift pump failure
issues.sym: Hard starting, stalling, a low fuel pressure warning, or a whine from the fuel system.
issues.why: The pump that feeds fuel to the high-pressure pump can fail. If the high-pressure pump then runs short of fuel it can shed metal through the system.
issues.next: Change fuel filters on time and buy diesel from busy stations. Have low fuel pressure checked right away.

issues.t: Alternator wiring can short and stall (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell, a battery or charging light, or the engine stalling.
issues.why: The alternator wiring may have been damaged when the engine was installed and can short.
issues.next: Get the free harness repair.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be switched off (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture does not appear when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: A display setting can hide the camera image and keep it hidden.
issues.next: Have the free software update done.

issues.t: Some Continental tires can fail (recall)
issues.sym: A bulge in the sidewall, a vibration, or sudden air loss.
issues.why: Some Continental tires fitted at the factory were over-cured.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the tire codes and replace affected tires free.

issues.t: Truck may not stay in Park and can roll away (recall)
issues.sym: The truck moves after you shift to Park.
issues.why: The parking pawl in the 9-speed automatic may not engage, so Park does not lock the wheels.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and get the free software update.

issues.t: Exposed engine harness wire can short (recall)
issues.sym: Stalling, a burning smell or smoke.
issues.why: A wire in the engine harness may be exposed and can short or arc.
issues.next: Get the free harness repair.

issues.t: Screen reboots and the backup camera goes dark (recall)
issues.sym: The center screen keeps restarting and the rear camera does not show.
issues.why: Software in the head unit can get stuck in a reboot loop, in some cases set off by a Sirius XM setting.
issues.next: Have the free software update done.

issues.t: Tire inner bead can tear (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden air loss.
issues.why: The inner bead of some tires may tear.
issues.next: Have the tires inspected and replaced free.

issues.t: Driver airbag may deploy improperly (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs.
issues.why: The driver airbag inflator can absorb moisture and may not deploy correctly.
issues.next: Have the free airbag replacement done.

issues.t: Airbag control unit can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag light may come on.
issues.why: The airbag control unit may be missing a spacer, so it can loosen and delay or prevent deployment. Some 2021 trucks are included too.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free repair done.
